title: DDA AutoTrader Usage Quota Policy

userAnalysisLimits.enforcement: atomic server-side reservation; denied or unavailable quota store fails closed

providerGlobalLimits.usageUnitDefinition: Provider-specific credits/cost units, supplied by the adapter from the selected vendor’s documented billing model; not currency unless explicitly mapped.
providerGlobalLimits.enforcementBoundary: Reserve atomically before every outbound provider request; provider adapter is not yet connected, so no provider consumption occurs today.

storage.atomicity: All bucket reservations in one call commit together or roll back together.

responsePolicy.exceeded: HTTP 429 with Retry-After when a reset time is available.
responsePolicy.quotaStoreUnavailable: HTTP 503; do not analyze or call a provider without a reservation.

notIncluded: vendor contract or vendor-enforced rate limits
monetary spend cap until the provider’s credit-to-currency schedule is configured
